encoding: 32 fixed Solidity ABI words, exactly 1024 bytes, no offsets or trailing data
bitcoin_hash_byte_order: raw SHA256d bytes, not reversed display hex
program_binding: The real proof verifier must pin the program/image ID and authenticate SHA256 of these exact journal bytes; this format is not proof authentication
batch_commitment: fork-policy framed SHA256, domain submitted-batch-v1, one length-framed part per complete submitted item in order, including ignored suffix bytes
halt_semantics: zero position and zero halt fields when running; otherwise position equals processed_count and depth exceeds 100, with safe-prefix head retained
time_semantics: unique newly verified headers only, including losing branches and halt candidate, excluding snapshots, duplicates and ignored suffix
no_change: a batch containing only exact known headers produces no journal and cannot refresh freshness
status: NEW_INTEGRATION; component-qualified only, no real guest/proof or production activation
